name: visitown
description: Visitown 저장소 루트: 빌드·테스트 스크립트와 workspaces(packages/engine·packages/ui·apps/web). 서버 런타임 의존성은 없다(server/package.json)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @visitown/engine -w @visitown/ui && npm run build -w @visitown/web
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/store.test.js tests/invariants.test.js tests/unlocks.test.js tests/sdk.test.js tests/engine.test.js tests/ui.test.js
scripts.test:api: node --test tests/api.test.js tests/limits.test.js tests/sse.test.js tests/peers.test.js tests/mcp.test.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p apps/web
